raw_excerpt: AUTO OPTION total: $157,150 to $326,850. HOME AND BUSINESS OPTION total: $154,650 to $311,850. Both ranges include Initial Franchise Fee ($59,900), vehicle ($2,000-$50,000), equipment/supplies/inventory/start-up package ($25,000-$65,000 for Auto; $25,000-$50,000 for H&B), insurance, advertising, training/travel, permits/licenses, professional fees, real estate, call center setup fee, and 3-month working capital ($36,750-$78,750).
